name: Hot Shot
source:
You're an intrepid sports reporter assigned to your favorite hockey team, but the notorious captain has been burned by your kind in the past.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Hot_Shot]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你是一名勇敢的体育记者，被分配到你最喜欢的曲棍球队，但臭名昭著的队长过去曾被你的同类烧死。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Hot_Shot]Choices Wikia[/url]]
